title: Assert bounded command recipe results
changes: Allow bounded JSON Pointer scalar assertions after a typed recipe action and include them in the pinned recipe identity; preserve serialization of recipes without assertions.
Evaluate and journal assertions against the terminal response, stop with assertion-failed before later actions, and validate stored checks on reload without reissuing the completed action.
validation: Windows GNU build and 27 focused Wine tests passed for typed/bounded assertions, missing versus null, pass/fail stop behavior, tamper detection, lost-response recovery and existing recipe/control contracts.

An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter session passed a status assertion, advanced one frame, failed a second assertion and confirmed that neither the next step nor an explicit resume advanced the guest; protected inputs stayed unchanged. A previously completed checkpoint without assertions was reread unchanged.

The first wide test run failed when the synthetic server panicked on a temporarily denied response publication; its outbox is designed to retry on later polls, and the corrected fixture and rerun passed.
limitations: Only the existing status, inspect and step runner actions are supported; waits, additional actions, interactive tool Start and real interrupted recovery remain open. The live unit keeps private scratch as a named current-proof exception; native Windows and interactive console entry were not tested.
